description: Defines the CookiePartitionKeyCollection class used to manage collections of cookie partition keys, including methods for creation, querying, and handling special cases like 'all keys'.

classes.name: CookiePartitionKeyCollection
classes.description: A class representing a collection of cookie partition keys, supporting operations like checking if it contains all keys, specific keys, or is empty.

methods.name: ContainsAll
methods.description: Creates a collection representing all possible cookie partition keys.

methods.name: FromOptional
methods.description: Creates a collection from an optional CookiePartitionKey; empty if optional is not set.

methods.name: Todo
methods.description: Temporary method returning an empty collection, used as a placeholder.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the collection is empty (no keys and not containing all keys).

methods.name: ContainsAllKeys
methods.description: Checks if the collection contains all possible keys.

methods.name: PartitionKeys
methods.description: Returns the set of partition keys if not containing all keys.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific key is in the collection.
